newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Frontier farms into offshore oil permits.
newsitem.headline: Frontier farms into offshore oil permits.

text.p: Frontier Petroleum NL said on Monday it had farmed into two oil prospects in the offshore southern region of the Bonaparte Basin, Western Australia.

Frontier said it had reached an agreement to earn a five percent interest in exploration permit WA-128-P (R2) and the adjacent NT/P46. The permits are held jointly by Cultus Petroleum NL and Todd Petroleum Mining Co.

The WA-128-P well was spudded on August 12 and is targeting a propsect containing potentially up to 200 million barrels of oil in place. Frontier said it would pay 10 percent of the cost of the Cape Ford-1 well being drilled in WA-128-P.
Frontier last week agreed to end litigation with Anzoil NL over Frontier's minority stake Anzoil (Asia) Pte, operator of Vietnam's onshore Hano Basin oil and gas field.
The settlement cancelled Anzoil's 18.3 percent stake in Frontier and provided Frontier with 7.6 percent of Anzoil.
